item.title: Pleasanton: Single-family home goes for $3.1 million
item.description: A single-family residence located in the 2500 block of Pomino Way in Pleasanton has a new owner since Dec. 12, 2025. The 3,208-square-foot home, built in 1997, was sold for $3,100,000, or $966 per square foot. This two-story house has four bedrooms and four bathrooms. Additionally, the house offers three parking spots. The property is set on a 0.6-acre lot, with an addition of a pool.
